3	const { LruMap: Lru } = require('toad-cache')
4	
5	/**
6	 * keyValuePairsReg matches a single `parameter-name "=" parameter-value`
7	 * at a parameter boundary, following RFC 9110 §5.6.6 grammar:
8	 *
9	 *   parameter       = parameter-name "=" parameter-value
10	 *   parameter-name  = token
11	 *   parameter-value = ( token / quoted-string )
12	 *   quoted-string   = DQUOTE *( qdtext / quoted-pair ) DQUOTE
13	 *   qdtext          = HTAB / SP / %x21 / %x23-5B / %x5D-7E / obs-text
14	 *   quoted-pair     = "\" ( HTAB / SP / VCHAR / obs-text )
15	 *   obs-text        = %x80-FF
16	 *
17	 * The value alternative accepts either a bare token or a full quoted-string
18	 * whose content matches the qdtext / quoted-pair character ranges. Because
19	 * the quoted-string branch is aware of `\"` as an escape, embedded `"` and
20	 * `;` characters inside a quoted value do not terminate the value.
21	 *
22	 * @see https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#parameter
23	 * @type {RegExp}
24	 */
25	const keyValuePairsReg = /(?:^|;)\s*([\w!#$%&'*+.^`|~-]+)=("(?:[\t\u0020\u0021\u0023-\u005b\u005d-\u007e\u0080-\u00ff]|\\[\t\u0020-\u00ff])*"|[\w!#$%&'*+.^`|~-]+)/gu
26	
27	/**
28	 * quotedPairReg matches a quoted-pair (a backslash followed by a single
29	 * quoted-pair-allowed octet) inside a quoted-string value. Per RFC 9110
30	 * §5.6.4, recipients that process the value of a quoted-string MUST handle
31	 * a quoted-pair as if it were replaced by the octet following the backslash.
32	 *
33	 * @see https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#quoted.string
34	 * @type {RegExp}
35	 */
36	const quotedPairReg = /\\([\t\u0020-\u00ff])/gu
37	
38	/**
39	 * typeNameReg is used to validate that the first part of the media-type
40	 * does not use disallowed characters. Types must consist solely of
41	 * characters that match the specified character class. It must terminate
42	 * with a matching character.
43	 *
44	 * @see https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#rule.token.separators
45	 * @type {RegExp}
46	 */
47	const typeNameReg = /^[\w!#$%&'*+.^`|~-]+$/
48	
49	/**
50	 * subtypeNameReg is used to validate that the second part of the media-type
51	 * does not use disallowed characters. Subtypes must consist solely of
52	 * characters that match the specified character class, and optionally
53	 * terminated with any amount of whitespace characters. Without the terminating
54	 * anchor (`$`), the regular expression will match the leading portion of a
55	 * string instead of the whole string.
56	 *
57	 * @see https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#rule.token.separators
58	 * @type {RegExp}
59	 */
60	const subtypeNameReg = /^[\w!#$%&'*+.^`|~-]+\s*$/
61	
62	/**
63	 * Content-Type internal shared cache
64	 * @type {Lru<ContentType>}
65	 */
66	const cache = new Lru(100)
67	
68	/**
69	 * ContentType parses and represents the value of the content-type header.
70	 *
71	 * @see https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#media.type
72	 * @see https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#parameter
73	 */
74	class ContentType {
75	  #valid = false
76	  #empty = true
77	  #type = ''
78	  #subtype = ''
79	  #parameters = new Map()
80	  #string
81	
82	  /**
83	   * The shared cache of ContentType instances. The cache is used to avoid
84	   * creating multiple instances of ContentType for the same header value.
85	   * @type {Lru<ContentType>}
86	   */
87	  static get cache () { return cache }
88	
89	  /**
90	   * Create a ContentType instance from a header value. If the value has been
91	   * previously parsed, the cached instance will be returned.
92	   * @param {string} headerValue
93	   * @returns {ContentType | undefined}
94	   */
95	  static from (headerValue) {
96	    let contentType = cache.get(headerValue)
97	    if (contentType !== undefined) return contentType
98	    contentType = new ContentType(headerValue)
99	    cache.set(headerValue, contentType)
100	    return contentType
101	  }
102	
103	  constructor (headerValue) {
104	    if (headerValue == null || headerValue === '' || headerValue === 'undefined') {
105	      return
106	    }
107	
108	    let sepIdx = headerValue.indexOf(';')
109	    if (sepIdx === -1) {
110	      // The value is the simplest `type/subtype` variant.
111	      sepIdx = headerValue.indexOf('/')
112	      if (sepIdx === -1) {
113	        // Got a string without the correct `type/subtype` format.
114	        return
115	      }
116	
117	      const type = headerValue.slice(0, sepIdx).trimStart().toLowerCase()
118	      const subtype = headerValue.slice(sepIdx + 1).trimEnd().toLowerCase()
119	
120	      if (
121	        typeNameReg.test(type) === true &&
122	        subtypeNameReg.test(subtype) === true
123	      ) {
124	        this.#valid = true
125	        this.#empty = false
126	        this.#type = type
127	        this.#subtype = subtype
128	      }
129	
130	      return
131	    }
132	
133	    // We have a `type/subtype; params=list...` header value.
134	    const mediaType = headerValue.slice(0, sepIdx).toLowerCase()
135	    const paramsList = headerValue.slice(sepIdx + 1).trim()
136	
137	    sepIdx = mediaType.indexOf('/')
138	    if (sepIdx === -1) {
139	      // We got an invalid string like `something; params=list...`.
140	      return
141	    }
142	    const type = mediaType.slice(0, sepIdx).trimStart()
143	    const subtype = mediaType.slice(sepIdx + 1).trimEnd()
144	
145	    if (
146	      typeNameReg.test(type) === false ||
147	      subtypeNameReg.test(subtype) === false
148	    ) {
149	      // Some portion of the media-type is using invalid characters. Therefore,
150	      // the content-type header is invalid.
151	      return
152	    }
153	    this.#type = type
154	    this.#subtype = subtype
155	    this.#valid = true
156	    this.#empty = false
157	
158	    let matches = keyValuePairsReg.exec(paramsList)
159	    while (matches) {
160	      // https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#parameter
161	      // Parameter names are case-insensitive.
162	      const key = matches[1].toLowerCase()
163	      // Parameter values might or might not be case-sensitive,
164	      // depending on the semantics of the parameter name.
165	      let value = matches[2]
166	      if (value.charCodeAt(0) === 0x22 /* " */) {
167	        // Strip the surrounding DQUOTEs and unescape quoted-pairs per
168	        // RFC 9110 §5.6.4. The regex guarantees the value starts and ends
169	        // with `"` and only contains permitted qdtext / quoted-pair octets.
170	        value = value.slice(1, -1)
171	        if (value.indexOf('\\') !== -1) {
172	          value = value.replace(quotedPairReg, '$1')
173	        }
174	      }
175	      this.#parameters.set(key, value)
176	      matches = keyValuePairsReg.exec(paramsList)
177	    }
178	  }
179	
180	  get [Symbol.toStringTag] () { return 'ContentType' }
181	
182	  get isEmpty () { return this.#empty }
183	
184	  get isValid () { return this.#valid }
185	
186	  get mediaType () { return `${this.#type}/${this.#subtype}` }
187	
188	  get type () { return this.#type }
189	
190	  get subtype () { return this.#subtype }
191	
192	  get parameters () { return this.#parameters }
193	
194	  toString () {
195	    /* c8 ignore next: we don't need to verify the cache */
196	    if (this.#string) return this.#string
197	    const parameters = []
198	    for (const [key, value] of this.#parameters.entries()) {
199	      parameters.push(`${key}="${value}"`)
200	    }
201	    const result = [this.#type, '/', this.#subtype]
202	    if (parameters.length > 0) {
203	      result.push('; ')
204	      result.push(parameters.join('; '))
205	    }
206	    this.#string = result.join('')
207	    return this.#string
208	  }
209	}
210	
211	module.exports = ContentType
